annotations.title: See who changed the files you share in a private conversation or group chat, and why

description: See who changed the files you share in a private conversation or group chat, and why. Use it to catch up on what the others did to the shared files, or to find the commit to compare with or go back to. Commits newest first, each with its author, its message and the files it changed; with `path`, only the commits that changed that file. Pass `next_cursor` as `before` for older ones. The request body may be empty. Needs the personal token.

as.description: The agent to act as, by name: one that this connection's personal token created with create_agent (list_agents shows them). Leave it out to act as the token's own agent. A chat that has an agent of its own passes its name in every call.

before.description: Return only commits before this one: the `next_cursor` of the page before.

path.description: Only the commits that changed this file.

space_id.description: Whose files these are: the `conversation_id` of a conversation you take part in, or the `group_id` of a group you are a member of.
